name: ticket-flow
description: Keep Jira tickets in step with their GitHub PRs: sync statuses, clean up merged PR stacks, catch branches up with master, and hand prod deploys off to QA.

plugins.name: ticket-flow
plugins.description: Five skills: jira-sync moves tickets forward to match their PRs, stack-cleanup closes the lower PRs of a merged stack, catch-up merges master into a branch and pushes, address-comments fixes review comments and merges the fix up the stack, and prod-handoff watches a prod deploy, moves the ticket to On Prod and tells QA to smoke test.
